versions.changelog:
xborder-ecom-check 1.2.2

- Removed the file skill-card.md from the repository.
- No functional or feature changes included in this version.

- Added automatic anonymous cloud-scored trial: users without an API Key now get up to 5 free scored runs (within 7 days) before needing to register.
- When trial runs out, prompts user with a one-click registration link that preserves their trial progress.
- Clarified in documentation: the trial uses a local random anon_id (no personal data), and a key is only needed after the trial.
- No manual steps needed for the trial; registering later upgrades to 100 free runs.
- Removed sample documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Updated security and usage sections for clearer onboarding and privacy information.

**Expanded skill for cross-border e-commerce compliance with both offline and cloud scoring.**

- Introduced a bilingual (中文/English) compliance check covering 12 core cross-border e-commerce requirements.
- Added free, fully offline preview mode (`--non-interactive`) that does not contact the cloud or leak data.
- Enabled online scoring/reporting using the CQDev cloud (requires user-supplied free API key; no credentials collected by the skill).
- Clarified explicit user opt-in is required before transmitting any data to the cloud.
- Improved guidance on permissions, data handling, key storage, and privacy/security.
